newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey may tender for 150,000-T barley export.
newsitem.headline: Turkey may tender for 150,000-T barley export.

text.p: Turkey's state grain board (TMO) is likely to invite an international tender soon to sell about 150,000 tonnes of feed barley from its stocks, a senior agriculture official said on Tuesday.
"The TMO holds nearly 500,000 tonnes of barley. It can sell about 350,000 tonnes locally and export the remaining 150,000 tonnes or so," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
"I do not know when the tender could be," he said.
But other grain officials said the tender date might be announced next week, but gave no other details.
Turkey had a barley harvest of about seven million tonnes in 1995/96 and sold 125,000 tonnes from its excess stocks to Glencore last September.
